<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check: does UP change the player's row when pressed from the current position?
# Current player is at row=29.0, col=62.0

# Press UP 5 times and track player position
print("Pressing UP 5 times:")
for i in range(5):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
            pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
            print(f"  After UP {i+1}: row={pr}, col={pc}")
            break

# Now press DOWN 5 times and track
print("\nPressing DOWN 5 times:")
for i in range(5):
    action(['DOWN'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
            pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
            print(f"  After DOWN {i+1}: row={pr}, col={pc}")
            break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
